name: @gofastr/whiteboard-board-bundle
description: In-frame whiteboard bundle for the GoFastr whiteboard plugin. Builds a single IIFE (Yjs + a small canvas controller) that runs inside the opaque-origin sandboxed iframe and speaks protocol v1 to the host over postMessage. The frame NEVER opens a connection: CRDT updates are opaque binary blobs that cross the bridge, and the host owns the only network leg.
